usage.summary:
Implemented the Docker Go transport, private helper, cleanup, regressions and documentation.

After 3 factory runs, the only remaining failure is [the lifetime fixture’s cleanup assertion](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plumbing-build-2273247835/internal/plumbing/docker_go_lifetime_591_accept_test.go:234): it checks for leftover directories before deferred `queue.Close()` removes the live queue socket directory. Correcting that fixture is outside the permitted scope.

The transport uses length-prefixed frames and stdin EOF cancellation. Recording that refinement and real Docker verification remain merger work.
